title: Add a priority to todo items
goal: Todo items carry a priority, so a list can show what matters first.

acceptance_criteria.text: New items have "priority": "normal" unless POST /todos gives one of "low", "normal" or "high".
Any other priority value, in POST /todos or PATCH /todos/:id, is refused with 400 and changes nothing.
PATCH /todos/:id can change the priority; all existing tests still pass.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
